module.name: Display tab
name: Name
history.name: Rename item
command.name: Renames the held item, or clears its name
command.lore: Lists, adds, sets, inserts or removes lore lines on the held item
command.lore.no_line: There's no lore line %s; the item has %s.
command.unbreakable: Toggles whether the held item is unbreakable
command.maxstacksize: Sets how many of the held item fit in a stack
command.maxstacksize.reset: The item's stack size is back to normal.
command.amount: Sets how many of the held item you have
command.amount.set: You now have %s of the item.
command.damage: Sets the held item's damage, or resets it
command.model: Sets the held item's custom model data, or clears it
command.model.set: The item's custom model data is now %s.
command.model.reset: Cleared the item's custom model data.
command.repaircost: Sets the held item's anvil repair cost, or resets it
command.repaircost.set: The item's repair cost is now %s.
command.color: Dyes the held item with a hex color, or clears the dye
command.color.invalid: %s isn't a hex color. Use something like #FF8800.
command.glint: Turns the enchantment glint on the held item on or off, or resets it
command.glint.on: The item now has an enchantment glint.
command.glint.off: The item no longer has an enchantment glint.
command.glint.reset: The item's glint is back to normal.
